mechanismOfAction.summary: Presumed AR agonist prodrug — benzoate ester hydrolysis releases RAD-140-like moiety.
mechanismOfAction.description: Nonsteroidal SARM; benzoate ester prodrug of a RAD-140 structural analog. Carboxylesterase hydrolysis presumed to yield active AR-agonist metabolite. No published receptor binding data for RAD-150 itself. Distinct molecule from RAD-140 (CAS 1208070-53-4 vs 1182367-47-0).
